[[Gwen's Flute (unique)]] is a [[unique item|unique]] [[focus item]] obtained through the quest [[Then and Now, Here and There]].

==Stats==
:[[Energy]] +12 (Requires 9 [[Inspiration Magic]])
:Halves skill recharge of [[spell]]s (Chance: 10%)
:[[Health]] +30
